title: The Earth with Hidden Layers
intro: This quiz follows Isla and Theo as they discover the different layers hidden inside Earth.

questions.prompt: Which layer of Earth do people live on?
What is the mantle mostly made of?
choices: A thick layer of very hot rock
questions.explanation: The mantle is mostly a thick layer of very hot rock.

questions.prompt: What is the outer core made of?
questions.explanation: The outer core is made of liquid metal.

questions.prompt: Why does the inner core remain solid even though it is extremely hot?
choices: It is surrounded by cold water
It receives no heat from the mantle
Enormous pressure at Earth's center keeps the metal solid
It is made only of stone
questions.explanation: Enormous pressure at Earth's center keeps the inner core solid even though it is extremely hot.

questions.prompt: Which list shows Earth's layers in the correct order from the outside to the center?
choices: Crust → mantle → outer core → inner core
Mantle → crust → inner core → outer core
Inner core → outer core → mantle → crust
Crust → outer core → mantle → inner core
questions.explanation: From the outside to the center, Earth's layers are crust, mantle, outer core, and inner core.
